title: Beautiful.ai Pricing 2026: Plans and Costs Compared
summary: Beautiful.ai pricing spans free and paid plans with varying feature limits and costs.
body_markdown:
## Beautiful.AI Plans and Prices Checked November 2026


Team runs $40–$50 per user a month, which means your Team bill scales with headcount


- Enterprise shows no public price
- Beautiful.ai is the AI presentation app, so the unit you pay for is a seat, not a deck


### The pricing table, plan by plan


The vendor page was checked on 18 November 2026, and the table shows what it states and where it says nothing.


Plan Monthly price Annual price per month Seats AI limits Export Sharing Brand features Trial


Pro Not stated $14.50 Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated


Team Not stated $40–$50 per user Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated


Enterprise Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated Not stated


Because I copied only what the vendor page confirms, most cells read "Not stated". G2 listings can differ from the vendor, so take figures from the vendor page only.


Count five seats and the Team rate, nearly three times Pro's, comes to $200–$230 a month, meaning your five-person team pays roughly $40-46 per person.


### What Pro and Team buy, and what I could not verify


"Not stated" in the table means I did not verify the item, not that the plan lacks it. I did not confirm AI generation limits, PowerPoint or PDF export, sharing rules, brand controls such as locked templates and fonts, or trial length for any plan.


Anything I filled in from memory would be a guess, and a guess about export or brand controls is exactly the kind that sends you to the wrong tier.


So the sticker price is only half the cost.


What Pro or Team buys depends on four lines you read on the vendor's page against your real usage: how many AI generations you need a month, which export formats your plan allows, whether brand controls sit on your tier, and whether a trial exists.


### How this article treats Team billing


The page figure I could confirm is a per-user monthly rate of $40–$50, and the five-seat figure above uses that basis, so the five-seat package doesn't reflect any volume discount.


The cost examples below use a different reading of Team, a $40 monthly base covering three seats, which comes to $480 a year, so they don't apply the per-user rates from above. I could not reconcile the two from the page.


Until the page settles it, price Team both ways and budget on the higher result: per-user rate times your editors, or the base plus the per-seat price for each seat beyond three. That second price is not stated anywhere I could confirm.


### Beautiful.AI Monthly vs Annual Pricing


Quote $12 for Pro and you are working from an old page, so the real price is higher than you're quoting. An older version showed Pro at $12–$15.[Beautiful.ai](https://www.beautiful.ai/pricing) 's current page shows $14.5–$15, so the low end has moved up by about 21%.


Put five seats and twelve months on Team's $40–$46 spread, which is $6 per user, and it's $360 between the cheapest and dearest reading, or $2,400–$2,760 in total.


### Free trial and what happens when it ends


I won't guess at a trial length or at what you keep afterwards, because the terms aren't stated in the figures I could confirm. Ask before you enter card details: does the deck you built stay editable, and can you still export it?


If you move work between tools, that export question matters, because whatever you automate starts from a file your plan lets you export.


[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) has a free plan at $0 with 1,000 credits a month and unlimited flows, so you can test that handoff before paying for anything. Read the export line on your own plan first.
